title: Pentagon UFO Files Detail FBI Agents' Report of Silent Black Triangle Above Ridge That Vanished in Seconds
Pentagon UFO Files Detail FBI Agents' Report of Silent Black Triangle Above Ridge That Vanished in Seconds
description: Newly released FBI and AARO records describe a silent, matte-black triangular object near a US security site, but differ over its timing and flight duration and provide no independent tracking evidence.

title: Britain’s new UFO capital revealed as 165 sightings are reported in just one year – is your area a spaceship hotspot?
description: LANCASHIRE has overtaken Yorkshire to become the UFO capital of Britain - after cops received 165 reports in a single year. Members of the public in the historic North West county reported mysterious lights, unidentified aerial phenomena and weird happenings. One caller claimed aliens had killed her cat and were now trying to kill her....

title: Defence Releases Seventh Set of UAP Documents Detailing Triangular Craft's 1,800‑mph Flight
description: The latest Department of Defense release contains a memo about a triangular flying object that rose silently, hovered, then vanished at 1,800 mph, with no debris detected; alongside reports from Skinwalker Ranch and other UAP incidents.
